shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every evening.
The weather is beautiful today, isn't it?
Eating healthy food is important for everyone.
I prefer tea over coffee in the morning.
Walking in the park helps me relax after work.
Traveling to new places opens your mind to culture.
Spending time with friends brings joy to my life.
Having a hobby can improve your mental health significantly.
Playing a musical instrument can be a rewarding experience.
Learning a new language can broaden your job opportunities.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite place you have traveled to?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important do you think travel is for personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: What obstacles do you encounter when trying to stay active?
Q3: Why do you think maintaining a regular exercise routine is important?
Q4: What tips would you suggest to someone starting a new fitness journey?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: Can you share a personal experience related to environmental conservation?
Q2: What challenges do people face when trying to be more eco-friendly?
Q3: In your opinion, how effective are current environmental initiatives?
Q4: What recommendations would you make to someone wanting to live more sustainably?
